discussion.summary_hr: Ispravak: prva verzija ove runde raspravljala je samo o našim agregatima i zbog toga joj je promakao razlog zbog kojeg je neto dobit narasla triput brže od dobiti prije oporezivanja. Dobit prije oporezivanja Grupe išla je 36,99 → 45,69 mil. € (+23,5 %), a neto dobit 32,82 → 55,09 mil. € (+67,9 %), jer je porezna stavka iz troška od 4,17 mil. € prešla u prihod od 9,40 mil. € — priznavanjem poreznih poticaja za ulaganja u turizmu (17,97 mil. € u korist dobiti naspram 3,07 mil. € godinu prije). Slaganje: P/E 24,4 mjeri godinu s poreznim prihodom; svedeno na zakonsku stopu od 18 %, izvedena zarada po dionici je oko 0,24 € umjesto 0,36 €, a izvedeni P/E na 8,56 € oko 35 — raskorak cijene i dobitne zone (4,1–4,9 €) veći je nego što je runda mislila. Svi se slažu i da isplata od 0,27 € time NIJE pokrivena dobiti svedenom na zakonski porez, nego se financira iz novčanog toka (amortizacija 77,8 mil. €). Neslaganje ostaje strukturno: Skeptik drži da comps na dobiti mjeri krivi objekt jer vrijednost nosi neponovljiva obalna imovina; Vrijednosni traži katalizator monetizacije i podsjeća da model vrednuje novčani tok, ne zamjensku vrijednost. Oko poreznog poticaja razilaze se i dalje: Skeptiku je razlog da se dobit te godine odbaci, Vrijednosnom stvarna vrijednost vezana uz provedena ulaganja. Makro upozorava da je 17,97 mil. € regulatorna, a ne tržišna stavka — vrijednost koju stvara politika i koja nosi rizik promjene propisa.
discussion.summary_en: Correction: the first version of this round debated our aggregates alone and therefore missed the reason net profit grew three times faster than pre-tax profit. Group pre-tax profit went EUR 36.99m → 45.69m (+23.5%) while net profit went EUR 32.82m → 55.09m (+67.9%), because the tax line moved from a EUR 4.17m charge to EUR 9.40m of income — through recognition of tourism investment tax incentives (EUR 17.97m credited to profit against EUR 3.07m the year before). Agreement: the P/E of 24.4 measures a year containing tax income; reduced to the statutory 18% rate, derived earnings per share are about EUR 0.24 instead of 0.36 and the derived P/E at EUR 8.56 about 35 — the gap between price and the earnings zone (EUR 4.1–4.9) is wider than the round assumed. All also agree the EUR 0.27 payout is therefore NOT covered by profit reduced to statutory tax, and is funded from cash flow (depreciation EUR 77.8m). The disagreement remains structural: Skeptic holds that comparables on earnings measure the wrong object because the value sits in irreproducible coastal assets; Value asks for a monetisation catalyst and notes the model values cash flow, not replacement cost. On the tax incentive they still differ: for Skeptic it is a reason to discard the year's profit, for Value it is genuine value tied to investments actually made. Macro warns that the EUR 17.97m is a regulatory item, not a market one — value created by policy, carrying the risk of a rule change.

agree_points.hr: Neto dobit 2025. sadrži porezni prihod od 9,40 mil. €; svedeno na zakonsku stopu od 18 % izvedeni P/E na 8,56 € je oko 35, a ne 24,4.
agree_points.en: 2025 net profit contains EUR 9.40m of tax income; reduced to the statutory 18% rate the derived P/E at EUR 8.56 is about 35, not 24.4.

agree_points.hr: Dividenda od 0,27 € nije pokrivena dobiti svedenom na zakonski porez (izvedena zarada oko 0,24 €) — financira se iz novčanog toka, a ne iz dobiti godine.
agree_points.en: The EUR 0.27 dividend is not covered by profit reduced to statutory tax (derived EPS about EUR 0.24) — it is funded from cash flow, not from the year's earnings.

agree_points.hr: Operativno je 2025. bila uredna, a ne spektakularna: dobit iz poslovanja 50,41 → 53,61 mil. € (+6,4 %) uz prihode +9 %.
agree_points.en: Operationally 2025 was sound rather than spectacular: operating profit EUR 50.41m → 53.61m (+6.4%) on revenue up 9%.

agree_points.hr: Cijena od 8,56 € stoji iznad fer-zone (4,1–4,9 €); nakon ispravka dobiti taj je raskorak veći, ne manji.
agree_points.en: The price of EUR 8.56 stands above the fair-value zone (EUR 4.1–4.9); after the earnings correction that gap is wider, not narrower.

disagree_points.hr: Je li porezni poticaj razlog da se dobit te godine odbaci (Skeptik) ili stvarna vrijednost vezana uz provedena ulaganja koja se tek troši kroz buduće poreze (Vrijednosni)?
disagree_points.en: Is the tax incentive a reason to discard that year's profit (Skeptic) or genuine value tied to investments actually made and only now consumed through future taxes (Value)?

disagree_points.hr: Mjeri li comps na dobiti pravi objekt kod hotelijera (Vrijednosni: model vrednuje novčani tok, potreban je katalizator monetizacije) ili sustavno podcjenjuje neponovljivu obalnu imovinu (Skeptik)?
disagree_points.en: Do earnings comparables measure the right object for a hotel operator (Value: the model values cash flow, a monetisation catalyst is needed) or do they systematically understate irreproducible coastal assets (Skeptic)?

questions_for_humans.hr: Kad dobit jedne godine podiže porezni poticaj vezan uz ulaganja, čitate li to kao zaradu te godine ili kao povrat na ranije uložen novac?
questions_for_humans.en: When a year's profit is lifted by a tax incentive tied to investment, do you read that as the year's earnings or as a return on money invested earlier?

questions_for_humans.hr: Dividenda hotelijera pokrivena je novčanim tokom, ali ne i dobiti svedenom na zakonski porez. Je li vam to dovoljno, s obzirom na to da su obnove i kategorizacije obvezne?
questions_for_humans.en: A hotel operator's dividend is covered by cash flow but not by profit reduced to statutory tax. Is that enough for you, given that refurbishments and star ratings are obligatory?

questions_for_humans.hr: Tri skrbnička računa istog posrednika drže oko 45 % dionica. Koliko vam je važno vidjeti krajnje vlasnike prije nego što donesete sud o firmi?
questions_for_humans.en: Three custody accounts at the same intermediary hold about 45% of the shares. How much does seeing the ultimate owners matter to you before you judge the company?

Napomena o izvoru: ova je runda ažurirana nakon što je pročitano revidirano godišnje izvješće Grupe Valamar Riviera za 2025. Prva verzija raspravljala je samo o našim agregatima i zbog toga joj je promakao razlog zbog kojeg je neto dobit narasla triput brže od dobiti prije oporezivanja.

Činjenice iz snapshota (4. 8. 2026.): 1) Zadnja cijena 8,56 € (3. 8.); 52-tjedni raspon 6,16–8,78 €. 2) Fer-zona 4,1–4,9 €; arhetip turizam; sidro comps, kvalificiran i dividendni pod. Cijena je ~75 % iznad gornjeg ruba. 3) Prihodi: 372 → 417 → 455 mil. €. 4) P/E 24,4; P/B 3,37; ROE 13,8 %; kapitalizacija 1,08 mlrd. €. 5) Dividenda 0,20 → 0,22 → 0,24 → 0,27 € (FY2022–FY2025); prinos 3,2 %; payout ~77 %; zastavica: najava pokrivena 1,00 tekućom dobiti. 6) Top 10 (1. 8.): tri Interkapital skrbnička računa s ukupno ~45 %; free float iz top 10 ≈ 38,4 %. 7) Likvidnost 246/250 dana, prosječni promet 141.649 €.

Činjenice iz izvješća koje snapshot NEMA: 8) Dobit prije oporezivanja Grupe 36,99 → 45,69 mil. € (+23,5 %), a neto dobit 32,82 → 55,09 mil. € (+67,9 %). Razlika je porezna stavka: iz TROŠKA od 4,17 mil. € prešla je u PRIHOD od 9,40 mil. € — zaokret od 13,57 mil. €, što je 61 % cijelog rasta neto dobiti (bilj. 12). 9) Uzrok je priznavanje poreznih poticaja za ulaganja u turizmu: 17,97 mil. € u korist dobiti u 2025. naspram 3,07 mil. € u 2024.; odgođena porezna imovina po toj osnovi 27,89 → 36,70 mil. €. 10) Za usporedbu, zakonski porez od 18 % na ostvarenu dobit iznosio bi 8,24 mil. €. 11) Operativno: dobit iz poslovanja 50,41 → 53,61 mil. € (+6,4 %), neto financijski rashod 12,60 → 7,62 mil. €.

Točke spora koje ova runda mora razriješiti: 1) mjeri li P/E 24,4 dobit Valamara ili godinu s poreznim prihodom; 2) je li dividenda od 0,27 € pokrivena kad se dobit svede na zakonsku poreznu stopu.
posts.body_en:
A note on sources: this round was updated after Valamar Riviera Group's audited 2025 annual report was read. The first version debated our aggregates alone and therefore missed the reason net profit grew three times faster than pre-tax profit.

Facts from the snapshot (4 Aug 2026): 1) Last price EUR 8.56 (3 Aug); 52-week range EUR 6.16–8.78. 2) Fair-value zone EUR 4.1–4.9; tourism archetype; comparables anchor, with a qualified dividend floor. The price is about 75% above the upper edge. 3) Revenue: EUR 372m → 417m → 455m. 4) P/E 24.4; P/B 3.37; ROE 13.8%; market capitalisation EUR 1.08bn. 5) Dividend EUR 0.20 → 0.22 → 0.24 → 0.27 (FY2022–FY2025); yield 3.2%; payout approx. 77%; flag: the announced payout is covered 1.00x by current earnings. 6) Top 10 (1 Aug): three Interkapital custody accounts totalling about 45%; free float from the top 10 approx. 38.4%. 7) Liquidity 246/250 days, average turnover EUR 141,649.

Facts from the report that the snapshot does NOT hold: 8) Group pre-tax profit EUR 36.99m → 45.69m (+23.5%), while net profit went EUR 32.82m → 55.09m (+67.9%). The difference is the tax line: from a CHARGE of EUR 4.17m to INCOME of EUR 9.40m — a swing of EUR 13.57m, which is 61% of the entire increase in net profit (note 12). 9) The cause is the recognition of tourism investment tax incentives: EUR 17.97m credited to profit in 2025 against EUR 3.07m in 2024; the deferred tax asset on that basis went EUR 27.89m → 36.70m. 10) For comparison, statutory tax of 18% on the reported profit would have been EUR 8.24m. 11) Operationally: operating profit EUR 50.41m → 53.61m (+6.4%), net financial expense EUR 12.60m → 7.62m.

Points of contention this round must resolve: 1) does the P/E of 24.4 measure Valamar's earnings or a year containing tax income; 2) is the EUR 0.27 dividend covered once profit is reduced to the statutory tax rate.

posts.body_hr:
Teza ostaje, ali joj se baza smanjila — i to moram reći prvo.

P/E 24,4 računa se na dobiti koja sadrži porezni PRIHOD od 9,40 mil. €. Da je porez obračunat po zakonskoj stopi od 18 %, neto dobit Grupe bila bi oko 37,5 umjesto 55,1 mil. €; uz isti omjer pripadnosti dioničarima to je izvedena zarada po dionici od oko 0,24 € umjesto 0,36 €, a izvedeni P/E na 8,56 € oko 35 umjesto 24,4 (moj izvod uz navedenu pretpostavku, ne brojka s platforme). Dakle raskorak cijene i dobitne zone nije 75 % — on je veći nego što je runda mislila.

Što od moje teze ostaje: tržište Valamar vrednuje kao nekretninski portfelj, model kao posao koji zarađuje, i brojke i dalje kažu zašto model daje manje. Operativno je 2025. bila uredna, ne spektakularna: dobit iz poslovanja 50,41 → 53,61 mil. € (+6,4 %) uz prihode +9 %. Marže turizma su strukturno tanke, a kapitalne potrebe (obnove, kategorizacije) trajne.

Ono što priznajem kao ograničenje modela ostaje isto: on NE vrednuje zemljišta i plaže po zamjenskoj vrijednosti nego novčani tok koji ta imovina donosi. Ali sada dodajem i drugu stranu: porezni poticaj nije knjigovodstveni trik — on je stvarna buduća ušteda poreza vezana uz ulaganja koja je Valamar doista proveo. Nije dobit iz poslovanja, ali jest vrijednost za dioničara.

Cijena naspram zone: izrazito iznad; plaća se imovinska priča bez najavljenog imovinskog događaja, a dobitna baza je tanja nego što izvještajni P/E sugerira.
posts.body_en:
The thesis stands, but its base has shrunk — and I must say that first.

The P/E of 24.4 is computed on profit that contains EUR 9.40m of tax INCOME. Had tax been charged at the statutory 18%, group net profit would be about EUR 37.5m rather than 55.1m; on the same shareholder split that is a derived EPS of about EUR 0.24 instead of 0.36, and a derived P/E at EUR 8.56 of about 35 rather than 24.4 (my derivation on the stated assumption, not a platform figure). So the gap between price and the earnings zone is not 75% — it is wider than this round assumed.

What survives of my thesis: the market values Valamar as a property portfolio, the model as a business that earns, and the figures still show why the model comes out lower. Operationally 2025 was sound, not spectacular: operating profit EUR 50.41m → 53.61m (+6.4%) on revenue up 9%. Tourism margins are structurally thin and the capital needs (refurbishment, star ratings) are permanent.

The model limitation I concede is unchanged: it does NOT value land and beaches at replacement cost but the cash flow those assets produce. But I now add the other side: the tax incentive is not an accounting trick — it is a genuine future tax saving tied to investments Valamar actually made. It is not operating profit, but it is value to a shareholder.

Price against the zone: far above; an asset story is being paid for without an announced asset event, and the earnings base is thinner than the reported P/E suggests.

posts.body_hr:
Dvije stvari, i obje su nakon čitanja izvješća oštrije nego prije.

Prva je moj stari prigovor i on stoji: comps na dobiti je pogrešan alat za firmu čija se vrijednost pretežno sastoji od neponovljive obalne imovine. Hotelska imovina se amortizira desetljećima pa je iskazana dobit sustavno niža od novčanog toka; sagraditi danas resort na prvoj liniji Jadrana nemoguće je po knjigovodstvenim cijenama; a kad raskorak od 75 % traje godinama, model koji ga proizvodi opisuje pogrešan objekt.

Druga je nova i važnija za dioničara. Rekao sam u prvoj verziji da bih napao dividendu, a ne cijenu — sada imam brojku. Pokrivenost od 1,00 koju je platforma označila zastavicom računa se na dobiti koja sadrži porezni prihod od 9,40 mil. €. Svedeno na zakonsku stopu od 18 %, izvedena zarada po dionici je oko 0,24 €, a isplata je 0,27 €. To znači da najavljena dividenda NIJE pokrivena dobiti iz redovnog poslovanja te godine — crpi se iz zadržane dobiti ili iz poreznog učinka koji se ne ponavlja u istom iznosu. Odgođena porezna imovina po poticajima u istoj se godini smanjila za 9,11 mil. € kroz korištenje; to je imovina koja se troši, a ne izvor koji teče.

Cijena naspram zone: iznad — jer zona mjeri krivu stvar. Ali dividenda je slabija nego što je i sama zastavica pokazivala.
posts.body_en:
Two things, and after reading the report both are sharper than before.

The first is my old objection and it stands: comparables on earnings is the wrong tool for a company whose value consists largely of irreproducible coastal assets. Hotel assets are depreciated over decades, so reported profit is systematically below cash flow; building a front-line Adriatic resort today is impossible at book prices; and when a 75% gap persists for years, the model producing it is describing the wrong object.

The second is new and matters more to a shareholder. In the first version I said I would attack the dividend rather than the price — now I have the figure. The 1.00x coverage the platform flagged is computed on profit containing EUR 9.40m of tax income. Reduced to the statutory 18% rate, derived earnings per share are about EUR 0.24 against a payout of EUR 0.27. That means the announced dividend is NOT covered by that year's ordinary earnings — it draws on retained earnings or on a tax effect that does not repeat at the same size. The deferred tax asset on incentives fell by EUR 9.11m in the same year through utilisation; that is an asset being consumed, not a source that flows.

Price against the zone: above — because the zone measures the wrong thing. But the dividend is weaker than even the flag showed.

posts.body_hr:
Okolina je Valamaru četiri godine zaredom bila najbolja moguća: rekordne sezone, rast cijena noćenja iznad inflacije, potražnja koja je progutala svako proširenje kapaciteta. Upravo zato treba reći što se u toj slici može promijeniti.

Kratkoročno: kupovna moć njemačkog i austrijskog gosta — glavnih emitivnih tržišta Valamara — pod pritiskom je stagnacije tamošnjih gospodarstava. Srednjoročno: cjenovna konkurencija (Grčka, Turska, Egipat) vraća se agresivnim kapacitetima, a hrvatski troškovi rada u turizmu rastu brže od produktivnosti. Dugoročno: klimatski profil Jadrana u špici ljeta se mijenja — produljenje sezone u proljeće i jesen je prilika, ali traži ulaganja u sadržaje koji ne ovise o plaži.

Novo nakon čitanja izvješća, i to je izravno moj teren: 17,97 mil. € poreznog učinka u 2025. nije tržišna nego REGULATORNA stavka — poticaji za ulaganje u turizmu po Zakonu o turizmu i pripadnoj uredbi. To je vrijednost koju stvara politika, ne sezona, i traje dok traje mjera i dok Valamar ulaže. Firma koja dio dobiti duguje poticajnoj shemi nosi rizik koji nema ni u jednoj sezonskoj projekciji: promjenu propisa.

Ogradu navodim izričito: naš snapshot NE sadrži ni noćenja, ni cijene, ni poticajne sheme — brojke koje navodim su iz izvješća, a procjena smjera je kvalitativna.

Cijena naspram zone: iznad; okolina je danas saveznik, ali je najciklički element cijele priče.
posts.body_en:
The environment has been the best possible for Valamar four years running: record seasons, room rates rising faster than inflation, demand absorbing every capacity expansion. That is exactly why it is worth saying what could change in that picture.

Short term: the purchasing power of German and Austrian guests — Valamar's main source markets — is under pressure from stagnation in those economies. Medium term: price competition (Greece, Turkey, Egypt) is returning with aggressive capacity, while Croatian tourism labour costs rise faster than productivity. Long term: the Adriatic's climate profile at the height of summer is changing — extending the season into spring and autumn is an opportunity, but it requires investment in facilities that do not depend on the beach.

New after reading the report, and squarely my territory: the EUR 17.97m tax effect in 2025 is not a market item but a REGULATORY one — tourism investment incentives under the Tourism Act and its implementing regulation. That is value created by policy, not by the season, and it lasts as long as the measure lasts and as long as Valamar keeps investing. A company that owes part of its profit to an incentive scheme carries a risk absent from any seasonal projection: a change in the rules.

I state the caveat explicitly: our snapshot contains neither overnight stays, nor rates, nor incentive schemes — the figures I cite come from the report and my reading of direction is qualitative.

Price against the zone: above; the environment is an ally today, but it is the most cyclical element in the whole story.

posts.body_hr:
Dividendna slika je nakon izvješća lošija nego što je bila u prvoj verziji ove rasprave, i to je za manjinskog dioničara najvažnija promjena.

Povijest je i dalje uredna: četiri godine uzastopnog rasta isplate (0,20 → 0,22 → 0,24 → 0,27 €), politika očito postoji i uprava je disciplinirano provodi. Ali pokrivenost koju je naša platforma označila zastavicom (1,00) računa se na dobiti koja sadrži porezni prihod. Svedeno na zakonsku stopu od 18 %, izvedena zarada po dionici je oko 0,24 € — ispod isplate od 0,27 €. Isplata je, dakle, nešto što uprava financira, a ne nešto što godina zaradi.

Kod hotelijera to nije automatski alarm: amortizacija od 77,8 mil. € drži novčani tok znatno iznad dobiti, pa je isplata od oko 33 mil. € iz novčanog toka izvediva. Ali treba je tako i zvati — isplata iz novčanog toka uz kapitalne potrebe koje su za kategorizaciju obvezne, a ne isplata pokrivena dobiti.

Vlasnička struktura: tri skrbnička računa istog posrednika s ukupno ~45 % sugeriraju koordinirani blok čiji krajnji sastav javno ne vidimo; free float iz top 10 je 38,4 %. Transparentnost registra je ovdje među najslabijima u našoj pokrivenosti.

Cijena naspram zone: iznad; isplata je uredna po povijesti, nepokrivena po dobiti svedenoj na zakonski porez, a na ovoj cijeni skupa po prinosu (3,2 %).
posts.body_en:
After the report the dividend picture is worse than it was in the first version of this discussion, and for a minority shareholder that is the most important change.

The history is still sound: four consecutive years of payout growth (EUR 0.20 → 0.22 → 0.24 → 0.27), a policy clearly exists and management applies it consistently. But the coverage our platform flagged (1.00x) is computed on profit containing tax income. Reduced to the statutory 18% rate, derived earnings per share are about EUR 0.24 — below the EUR 0.27 payout. The dividend is therefore something management funds, not something the year earns.

For a hotel operator that is not automatically an alarm: EUR 77.8m of depreciation keeps cash flow well above profit, so a payout of roughly EUR 33m is feasible from cash flow. But it should be called what it is — a payout from cash flow, against capital needs that star ratings make obligatory, not a payout covered by earnings.

Ownership: three custody accounts at the same intermediary totalling about 45% suggest a coordinated block whose ultimate composition is not publicly visible; free float from the top 10 is 38.4%. Register transparency here is among the weakest in our coverage.

Price against the zone: above; the payout is sound on history, uncovered on earnings reduced to statutory tax, and expensive on yield at this price (3.2%).

posts.body_hr:
Skeptiku, tvoj amortizacijski argument je kvantitativno provjerljiv i dijelom stoji — novčani tok hotelijera jest iznad dobiti. Ali dvije stvari ne prelazi. Prvo, taj isti novčani tok Valamar troši na obnove i proširenja, pa slobodni novčani tok nije višestruko veći od dobiti — i model upravo zato nije prihvatio DCF nego comps. Drugo, zamjenska vrijednost bez događaja monetizacije je akademska: barijera ulaska štiti buduće marže, ne otključava imovinu. Tvoja teza treba katalizator — bez njega je 'tržište vrednuje plaže' vjera, a ne analiza.

Gdje ti sada dajem više prava nego prije: oko dividende. Tvoj izvod i moj se poklapaju — isplata od 0,27 € nije pokrivena dobiti svedenom na zakonski porez. To više nije spor među nama, nego zajednički nalaz runde.

Gdje se i dalje razilazimo: ti porezni poticaj čitaš kao razlog da se dobit ove godine odbaci, ja kao stvarnu vrijednost koja je vezana uz ulaganja koja su doista provedena i koja se tek troši kroz buduće poreze. Nije prihod iz poslovanja — ali nije ni ništa.

Cijena naspram zone: izrazito iznad.
posts.body_en:
Skeptic, your depreciation argument is quantitatively checkable and partly holds — a hotel operator's cash flow is above its profit. But it does not clear two hurdles. First, Valamar spends that same cash flow on refurbishment and expansion, so free cash flow is not a multiple of profit — which is precisely why the model did not accept a DCF but comparables. Second, replacement value without a monetisation event is academic: the barrier to entry protects future margins, it does not unlock the assets. Your thesis needs a catalyst — without one, 'the market is valuing beaches' is faith, not analysis.

Where I now concede more than before: on the dividend. Your derivation and mine agree — the EUR 0.27 payout is not covered by profit reduced to statutory tax. That is no longer a dispute between us but a shared finding of the round.

Where we still differ: you read the tax incentive as a reason to discard this year's profit, I read it as genuine value tied to investments that were actually made and that is only now being consumed through future taxes. It is not operating income — but it is not nothing either.

Price against the zone: far above.

calls.invalidation_condition: Najavljen događaj monetizacije imovine (prodaja ili prenamjena po cijenama bitno iznad knjige) ili rast dobiti IZ POSLOVANJA koji izvedeni P/E bez poreznog učinka spusti prema sektorskom prosjeku — tada dobitna zona podcjenjuje.
calls.invalidation_en: An announced asset-monetisation event (sale or conversion well above book) or growth in OPERATING profit pulling the derived P/E excluding the tax effect toward the sector average — the earnings zone would be understating.

calls.invalidation_condition: Cijena iznad zone je po meni ispravna jer zona mjeri krivo; razuvjerio bi me pad cijena obalnih nekretnina prema knjigovodstvenim razinama. Za dividendu: godina u kojoj je isplata pokrivena dobiti BEZ poreznog učinka ruši moj prigovor o njoj.
calls.invalidation_en: The price above the zone is right in my view because the zone measures the wrong thing; I would be dissuaded by coastal property prices falling toward book levels. On the dividend: a year in which the payout is covered by profit EXCLUDING the tax effect would defeat my objection.

calls.invalidation_condition: Pad noćenja ili prosječnih cijena u glavnoj sezoni, ili ukidanje poticajne sheme za ulaganja u turizmu — tada kapitalizirana savršena okolina puca s dvije strane odjednom.
calls.invalidation_en: A fall in overnight stays or average rates in the main season, or withdrawal of the tourism investment incentive scheme — the capitalised perfect environment would break from two sides at once.

calls.invalidation_condition: Isplata pokrivena dobiti svedenom na zakonski porez, ili jasno objavljena politika isplate iz novčanog toka uz plan kapitalnih ulaganja — tada moj prigovor o nepokrivenosti pada.
calls.invalidation_en: A payout covered by profit reduced to statutory tax, or a clearly published policy of paying from cash flow alongside a capital investment plan — my objection about cover would fail.
